top_signals.title: ICTSI: Keen to Expand in Southern, Western Africa
top_signals.summary:
International Container Terminal Services Senior Adviser Christian Gonzalez says the world’s largest, independent terminal operator is keen to expand in Southern and Western Africa. It currently has 34 terminal operations and port development projects across 19 countries. He speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin."

 (Source: Bloomberg)
